create_categorical_distribution_from_log: create a Categorical distribution initialized with logits and a specified dtype for JAX-based sampling
create_categorical_distribution_from_pro: create a Categorical distribution initialized with probability values for discrete probabilistic modeling
sample_from_categorical: sample random category indices from a Categorical distribution using a JAX PRNG key
compute_log_prob_categorical: compute the log probability of given category values under a Categorical distribution
compute_kl_divergence_categorical: compute the KL divergence between two Categorical distributions with matching category counts
